1939-7684-7690.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1939-7684-7690.description:
Gain life.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a 0/4 Wall creature token.
When the Wall enters, Lunarch Veteran triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

4222-4289-8299.description:
Activate Hemmer by tapping it, adding {U}.
Hemmer triggers, causing you to loot
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Hemmer.
Repeat.

2585-2829-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2585-2829-5660-6769.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Grim Monolith, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Ravager.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Grim Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist

728-7936--5.notablePrerequisites: The creature with persist has a +1/+1 counter on it.
728-7936--5.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. Choose to have it enter as a copy of the creature with persist with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from Dominion Saboteur as a state-based action.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

710-7424-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4871-5220-6650-8095.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
4871-5220-6650-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-6650-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-6719.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2921-6719.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2292-4153-4186--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 5.

3257-5411-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Rakdos Carnarium.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Rakdos Carnarium from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Repeat.

5641-7687-7737.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
5641-7687-7737.description:
Draw a card.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mister Fantastic triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

215-1902-4359.notablePrerequisites: There are at least six Elves on the battlefield.
215-1902-4359.description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Wirewood Channeler from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Channeler by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3113-6500.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Tephraderm indestructible.
3113-6500.description:
Activate Tephraderm by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Tephraderm triggers, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw.

240-2079-5256-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.

546-4613-5900-7230.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost 5 or more life this turn.
546-4613-5900-7230.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cryptborn Horror. Cryptborn Horror enters with at least five +1/+1 counters due to its replacement effect.
Activate Cryptborn Horror using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

2511-4681-5170-6559.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Venerated Stormsinger trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2511-5571-7046--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-671-3490-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-671-3490-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
When the Servo dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

671-3054-3416-5670.easyPrerequisites: You've gained life this turn if Oathsworn Vampire is in your graveyard.
671-3054-3416-5670.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire either from your hand or graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the Vampire and Oathsworn Vampire enter, Daxos triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire dies, Daxos triggers, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat steps 4 through 6 once, sacrificing the Vampire token instead.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

2099-4112-6767.description:
Cast Rescue Skiff by paying {5}{W}.
When Rescue Skiff enter the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Sharuum.
Holding priority, activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Rescue Skiff trigger, returning Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff.
Holding priority, activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Rescue Skiff from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

542-2364.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}{C}.
542-2364.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning a nontoken permanent that can be cast using {C}{C} from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Cast the nontoken permanent returned in step 2 by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

440-1339-4050-4476.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-4050-4476.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1308-2793-3743-5089.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
392-1308-2793-3743-5089.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Harnfel by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

1987-2556-3617-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-2556-3617-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mnemonic Wall.
When Mnemonic Wall and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

2653-5414-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You control at least eight lands.
2653-5414-5720-5721.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Nissa triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Nissa's trigger.

2292-2867-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the Robot.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

215-3426-4050-4365.description:
Cast Deranged Hermit by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Deranged Hermit enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating eight 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar seven times by sacrificing seven Squirrels, adding {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deranged Hermit to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

360-2966-3253-4613.notablePrerequisites:
Zopandrel has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional permanent.
360-2966-3253-4613.description:
Activate Zopandrel using Myojin of Blooming Dawn's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
When the Spirits enter the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Activate Zopandrel by paying 4 life and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
If you control at least two additional permanents as the combo starts, this combo nets infinite lifegain and creature tokens.

1656-3371-3812.manaNeeded: {4}, plus enough mana to pay for the nonland card's mana cost minus {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
1656-3371-3812.notablePrerequisites:
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one nonland card in hand.
1656-3371-3812.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Codie's ability by paying {4} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping Necrotic Ooze.
Repeat as desired, skipping step 2 on the final iteration.
Cast any spell by paying its mana cost, reduced by the {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} added in step 1.
Necrotic Ooze triggers for each time you activated Codie's ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each nonland card in your hand as mana permits, and on subsequent turns.

uses.n: Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist // Jetfire, Air Guardian

114-3263-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites:
Ingenious Scholar on the battlefield as Jetfire, Air Guardian.
Jetfire has no +1/+1 counters on it.
114-3263-3490-4659.description:
Activate Jetfire, Air Guardian by paying {3}, converting it and putting three +1/+1 counters on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Jetfire, Ingenious Scientist by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3} and converting Jetfire.
Repeat.

317-4050-5189.notablePrerequisites: A creature you control has a +1/+1 counter on it.
317-4050-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

430-1061-3730.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
430-1061-3730.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Master of the Wild Hunt triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator, paying {2}{U}{U} and putting Timestream Navigator on the bottom of your library to take an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
